content.value: Workflow: pick a project card below, edit its title and task inline, then move each task through Todo → Doing → Done. Every card owns its own controls and state; Save in Studio preserves your edits as the new starting defaults.

This card owns its own title and task canvas. Edit the project title, rename the task, and choose Todo, Doing or Done for its status. Changes here affect only this card — Save in Studio keeps them as the starting defaults.
